ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low high-to-low intensity ratio; the visible ventral surface is approximately 98% low-intensity (black) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to distal tip regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black) region spanning the entire visible fluke surface; high-intensity (white) contiguous clusters are localized specifically at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration across the entirety of the trailing edge; characterized by a continuous series of peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 4 to 18 pixels, creating a jagged margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge exhibits a concave upward sweep from the water-obscured central axis towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small clusters of high-intensity (white) pixels located at the far edges of the distal tips, consistent with localized surface scarring or barnacle attachment points.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep, irregular notch/indentation on the distal end of the left lobe; non-uniform serration profile along the trailing edge suggestive of accumulated trauma or extensive wear.
other_distinctive_markers: The overall profile of the trailing edge is exceptionally jagged and irregular across the entire visible span compared to standard smooth or moderately serrated fluke margins.
